textData.text: Calling all Valorant players! Ascend the ranks and dominate the new map, Lotus, by understanding powerful agent combinations. This guide, will equip you with the knowledge to strategize winning team comps for both Attack and Defense on Lotus!

Lotus is a unique three-site map featuring interconnected pathways and hidden corners. It encourages strategic movement, map control, and coordinated attacks/defenses. Here's how agent selection can make a big difference:
Agents with abilities that block areas, gather intel, or slow enemy pushes are crucial for holding or taking sites.
Lotus has long rotations between sites. Agents that can help your team move quickly or block enemy rotations are valuable.
Planting and defending the Spike requires specific skills. Agents with smokes, flashes, and abilities to control areas become essential.
Her turrets and alarmbots lock down areas, while her Nanoswarm ultimate can block enemy pushes.
Her electrical speed boosts and wall breaches allow for quick site entries and rotations.
His concussive blasts and blinding flashes help disorient enemies before entering a site.
Her guiding lights reveal enemy positions, while her trails and concussive blasts control enemy movement.
Her grenades and satchel charges excel at clearing corners and flushing out defenders.

This combination provides a good balance of offense and utility. Killjoy anchors a site, while Neon facilitates fast rotations and site entries. Breach and Skye help gather intel and control enemy movement. Raze's grenades clear out hidden enemies and create openings for planting the Spike.
His smokes and teleports can aid in strategic site fakes and confusing enemy rotations.
His recon arrows scout enemy positions, while his disabler arrows can disable Killjoy's turrets or other utility.
His traps and camera network excel at intel gathering and revealing enemy positions on a map with many flanks.
His tripwires and teleport anchor a site, while his powerful sniper rifle eliminates attackers from afar.
Her toxic clouds and poison orbs control areas, restricting enemy movement and slowing down pushes.
His smokes block enemy vision, while his paranoia can disorient attackers trying to enter a site.
His smokes and incendiaries can control key choke points and deny areas to attackers.

This defensive lineup focuses on holding sites and gathering intel. Cypher reveals enemy positions with his traps and camera. Chamber anchors a site with his tripwires and sniper rifle. Viper and Omen restrict enemy movement with their smokes and abilities. Brimstone provides additional area denial with his incendiaries.
Her astral stars can block enemy vision lines and create one-way smokes for defenders.
Her heals and barrier orbs can support teammates in drawn-out fights, while her slow orb can delay enemy pushes.
